messages:
maria-sales: Hey team — ClearHealth wants to kick off a 4-week POC next Tues. They asked for SOC 2 Type II report, ISO27001 scope, pen-test letter, and staging KMS access. Can we bundle these?

sam-eng: We can share network diagram and infra runbook. Staging KMS keys: we don't hand out customer root keys — we can create scoped test keys in a staging KMS account. Need ops to provision.

olivia-sec: For SOC2/ISO artifacts we can provide redacted reports and scope statement. Pen-test letter: we have a template but legal needs to sign and we only issue attestation after minimal contract (POC A/N).

jordan-ops: I can provision scoped staging keys and a short-lived service account. Need exact principal email + expiry window. Also will need IP allowlist for their scanners if they want to run external scans.

mike-ps: Pricing note: POC evidence support is included for standard POCs. If they want Dedicated or on-prem staging, that changes pricing — estimate add-on ~ $8k/mo for reserved GPUs during POC (rough).

maria-sales: Quick Qs for ops: principal is clearhealth-poc@clearhealth.com, expiry 30 days. They want pen-test window in week 3. For legal — is the pen-test letter something you sign before or after they run their scan?

lia-legal: We can sign a pen-test authorization letter but need scope + target IPs and confirmation of insurance/indemnity terms. We prefer to sign within a week prior to the test. Also need to ensure data handling clauses in the PoC MSA.

olivia-sec: Recommend we provide: (1) redacted SOC2 PDF (2) ISO27001 scope excerpt (3) network diagram + runbook (4) pen-test auth template for their vendor to fill. I'll attach templates.

sam-eng: Template links: https://internal.redwood/docs/poc/runbook.md and network diagram: https://internal.redwood/diagrams/poc-net-v1.png

jordan-ops: @maria-sales please confirm IP ranges they'll test from and whether scans are authenticated. If authenticated, we need credentials to a short-lived scan user (no KMS access).

maria-sales: Confirmed — scans unauthenticated from vendor IP 52.14.120.0/24. They asked if we can provide an SFTP drop for evidence; we can provide a signed URL or S3 pre-signed.

mike-ps: If they convert to Dedicated during POC there is a setup fee (~$15k) and we need 2-week lead time to reserve capacity. Call this out to the buyer.

olivia-sec: I'll prepare the redacted SOC2 + ISO excerpt. @lia-legal can you review the pen-test template and add signature block?

lia-legal: On it. I need the customer-facing name/POC and the exact scan window so I can populate the letter.

maria-sales: POC contact: Ben Carter (ben@clearhealth.com). Scan window requested: 2026-06-23 to 2026-06-24.

jordan-ops: Provisioning checklist: create staging service account, add IP allowlist 52.14.120.0/24, create scoped KMS key (encrypt-only), S3 presigned folder for evidence. ETA: 2 business days after I get principal email & PO signal.

sam-eng: One last note — if they ask for raw logs we should provide aggregated logs and a sanitized datadump only; no PHI. Keep that in the PoC data handling annex.

maria-sales: Great — I'll reply to the buyer with timeline and request PO signal. Action items: maria -> send PO signal + ben email to ops; jordan -> provision keys & s3; olivia -> assemble SOC2/ISO; lia -> pen-test letter draft; mike -> send dedicated pricing addendum if asked. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy 2539990002 by jordan-ops: staging-kms-provision requested — ETA 2d.
